lines.japanese: 「えと、行こうと思って行けるものじゃないかもしれないけど……」
lines.english: “Um... I know it may not be the sort of place I can reach just by deciding to go...”

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫。羽田君が行けるまで、何度でも付きあう」
lines.english: “It's all right. However many tries it takes, I'll stay with you until you make it there.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Mm-hm.”

lines.japanese: 僕は千歳くんと≪面談≫するために、部屋で眠りにつくことにした。
lines.english: I decided to fall asleep in my room so that I could hold an Interview with Chitose.

lines.japanese: ただ僕がグレタガルドに行くときは、いつも自分の意思とは関係なく召喚されていたから、今回は上手くいくかは分からない。
lines.english: But every time I had gone to Gretagard, I had been summoned there without any say in the matter. I had no idea whether it would work this time.

lines.japanese: でも山科さんが僕の隣りで、手を握って側にいてくれる。僕たちは同じふとんの中で、お互いの意思を強く信じた。
lines.english: But Yamashina lay beside me, holding my hand and staying close. Under the same blanket, we each placed our deepest faith in the other's will.

lines.japanese: 「私がよく行くコミュにもＤＩＤ──羽田君と同じ障害の子がいてね。ちょっと聞いたことあるんだけど、ＤＩＤの場合、だいたい内部の助力者がいるものなんだって」
lines.english: “There’s someone with DID—the same disorder as you—in an online community I visit a lot. I’ve asked a little about it, and apparently people with DID usually have an internal helper.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、その助力者みたいな人格──インナーセルフヘルパーって言ったかな、そのひとに会えれば、いい方向に導いてもらえるんだと思う」
lines.english: “So if you can meet the personality who acts as that helper—an 'Inner Self Helper,' I think it was—then I think that person can guide you in the right direction.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ行ってくるね」
lines.english: “Then I'll be off.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。いってらっしゃい」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. See you when you get back.”

lines.japanese: 僕たちは学校にでも出かけるような口ぶりで挨拶を交わした。
lines.english: We exchanged farewells as casually as though I were setting off for school.

lines.japanese: 目を閉じる。意識を薄くする。まどろみの中へ落ちていく。
lines.english: I closed my eyes. Thinned my consciousness. Sank into the borderland of sleep.

lines.japanese: いつもグレタガルドに行くときは……そうだ、この次元の壁を溶かそうと、金色の粒子が一面に広がるように、夢寐の向こう側へと意識を伸ばしていく。
lines.english: Whenever I went to Gretagard... Yes. I reached my awareness beyond the realm of dreams, imagining golden particles spreading everywhere, melting the wall between dimensions.

lines.japanese: この彼方、空の繋がっていない世界を目指して、雲を突きぬけるような速度と無限に漂うような浮遊感を重ねて頭の中を空にしていく。
lines.english: I aimed for that distant world whose sky did not join this one. I overlaid the speed of piercing the clouds with the sensation of drifting forever, and emptied my mind.

lines.japanese: もう考えるのは止めよう。
lines.english: No more thinking.

lines.japanese: もうここから遠い世界に旅立とう。
lines.english: Now I would depart for a world far from here.

lines.japanese: もう白い霞の海に流されてしまおう。
lines.english: Now I would surrender myself to the sea of white mist.

lines.japanese: ……これは。
lines.english: ...This is—

lines.japanese: これは、鳶の鳴き声とは違う。
lines.english: This was not the cry of a kite.

lines.japanese: あのとき僕の意識を別の場所に移した、鐘の音。
lines.english: It was the sound of bells—the bells that had carried my consciousness somewhere else before.

lines.japanese: 「ここは、あのときの……」
lines.english: “This is... the place from before.”

lines.japanese: 僕はこの場所を知っている。まるで知識のなかった前回とは違い、背後にある扉の意味も分かっていた。
lines.english: I knew this place. Unlike the first time, when I had understood nothing, I now knew what the doors behind me meant.

lines.japanese: 正面にある祭壇に背を向け、赤い絨毯を逆流して歩く。向かって右から二番目の扉を、自分から叩こうとした。
lines.english: I turned my back on the altar and walked upstream along the red carpet. I was about to knock, of my own accord, on the second door from the right.

lines.japanese: 「ぼんじゅーる」
lines.english: “Bonjour.”

lines.japanese: その前に扉は開き、中から軽い声が聞こえてきた。一度しか会ったことのない僕の弟、千歳くんだ。
lines.english: Before I could knock, the door opened and a breezy voice greeted me from inside. It was my younger brother Chitose, whom I had met only once.

lines.japanese: 「おんや？　なんだか間隔短くない？　俺の気のせい？」
lines.english: “Well, now? Isn't this awfully soon? Or is that just me?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、おれが自分の意思でここに来たんです」
lines.english: “No. I came here of my own free will.”

lines.japanese: 「あらま！」
lines.english: “Well, I'll be!”

lines.japanese: 千歳くんは両手を斜め上に流す、古典的なジェスチャーで驚きを表現した。
lines.english: Chitose expressed his amazement with the classic gesture of flinging both hands up and out at an angle.

lines.japanese: 「≪面談≫のやり方も知らないのに、一人で頑張ってここにきちゃったわけだ。そりゃ凄いねえ。ていうか、苦労してこの方法編み出した俺ってどうなのよ」
lines.english: “You didn't even know how to do an Interview, but you still made it all the way here on your own. That's pretty amazing. Though after all the work I put into coming up with this method, what does that make me?”

lines.japanese: 「はは、おれも一人じゃないんです」
lines.english: “Ha ha. I wasn't alone either.”

lines.japanese: 「ほ？　と言うと？」
lines.english: “Oh? How so?”

lines.japanese: 千歳くんの質問に僕は答えられなかったけど、返事に困っている様子を見て察してくれたみたいだ。
lines.english: I could not answer Chitose's question. But when he saw me floundering for a reply, he seemed to work it out for himself.

lines.japanese: 「ほう！　タカシ君が！　まあ！　まあまあ！　もしかして、あの綺麗なお嬢さんじゃないよね～え？」
lines.english: “Oh! Takashi has! My! My, my! Don't tell me it was that beautiful young lady?”

lines.japanese: 「ちなみに俺は失恋したばかりだから気をつけろー。返答次第によっちゃ愛しのマイブロウと言えど、痛いと言うまで肩甲骨の出っぱったところをぶつよ」
lines.english: “For the record, I've just had my heart broken, so watch yourself. Depending on that answer, beloved bro or no, I'll thump the knobby part of your shoulder blade until you say uncle.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そのひとではないです。渡来さんは仮面彼女なんで」
lines.english: “Oh, it wasn’t her. Watarai is only my pretend girlfriend.”

lines.japanese: 「す、すみません」
lines.english: “I-I'm so sorry.”

lines.japanese: 何故か千歳くんは深々と頭を下げた。
lines.english: For some reason, Chitose bowed very deeply.

lines.japanese: 「あの、山科さんっていうんですけど、おれの大事な恋人なんです」
lines.english: “Um, her name is Yamashina. She’s my girlfriend, and she means a lot to me.”

lines.japanese: 「うひょう！　山科さーん！　イエス！　山科イエス！　うちのタカシを末永くお隣に据えてやってくださいねー！　山科ばんざああい！」
lines.english: “Woo-hoo! Yamashina! Yes! YES to Yamashina! Please keep our Takashi installed beside you for many happy years to come! Long live Yamashinaaaa!”

lines.japanese: 「はい、とってもかわいいひとなんです」
lines.english: “Yes. She's very cute.”

lines.japanese: 「マジレスされると腹立つな。失恋したばかりだから気をつけろっつってんだろ」
lines.english: “God, it annoys me when you answer the gag seriously. I told you I just had my heart broken. Watch yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「す、すみません」
lines.english: “I-I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「で、その山科さんのために、一人でここに来たってわけだ」
lines.english: “So it was for this Yamashina that you made it here on your own.”

lines.japanese: 「あの……え？　あ、はい」
lines.english: “Um... what? Oh. Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「ようがす、みなまで言うなマイブロウ。君のその心意気、俺たち代表俺はしかと受けとったぞ」
lines.english: “Very good. Say no more, my bro. I, the representative of all of us, have received that fighting spirit of yours loud and clear.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ？　千歳くん……？」
lines.english: “Huh? Chitose...?”

lines.japanese: 千歳くんは親指を立てて口幅いっぱいの笑顔を浮かべると、手をひらひらと振って背中を向けた。
lines.english: Chitose thrust up his thumb and grinned from ear to ear. Then he gave me a jaunty wave and turned his back.

lines.japanese: 「えっ、あの、千歳くんっ！？」
lines.english: “Wait—Chitose?!”

lines.japanese: 「ほんとなら俺と隼人君も、君に直接伝えたいことはいっぱいあったんだけどね。惜しむらくは時間かな」
lines.english: “Ordinarily, Hayato and I would've had plenty we wanted to tell you ourselves. Sadly, time's the one thing we haven't got.”

lines.japanese: 「その代わり、俺たちの知識やら経験やらは、タカシ君の中に残ると思うんだ。それを羽田タカシの人生に役立ててくれよマイブロウ」
lines.english: “But I think our knowledge and experience will remain inside you. Put them to good use in the life of Takashi Haneda, my bro.”

lines.japanese: 「あのっ、おれまだお礼とか……！」
lines.english: “Wait! I haven't even thanked you yet...!”

lines.japanese: 「隼人君がそーだったように、俺も立つ鷲跡を濁さず？　なんつか涙とか出ちゃいそうなんで、そんなん。ははん」
lines.english: “Like Hayato, I’d better make a clean exit. A departing eagle leaves the water clear—or however that saying goes. If I stick around, I might start crying. Hah.”

lines.japanese: 「もっとも、あとはタカシ君次第なんだけどね。俺たちは道を譲っただけ、そのあとを切りひらいていくのは自分自身だってことをお忘れなくー」
lines.english: “Of course, the rest is up to you, Takashi. All we did was yield the road. Don't forget: you're the one who has to carve out the path beyond it.”

lines.japanese: 「ほんじゃタカシ君、また来世ー」
lines.english: “Well then, Takashi. See you in the next life.”

lines.japanese: 千歳くんの最後にちらと見えた横顔は、自分と同じ体の中にいるとは思えないくらいかっこ良かった。
lines.english: In the last glimpse I caught of his profile, Chitose looked impossibly cool for someone who lived inside the same body as me.

lines.japanese: 僕は扉の中の光の向こうに消えていく千歳くんを見送って、そのまま意識の濁流に飲み込まれていった。
lines.english: I watched Chitose disappear beyond the light inside the doorway. Then the torrent of consciousness swallowed me whole.

lines.japanese: 世界が白い靄に包まれている。
lines.english: The world was wrapped in white haze.

lines.japanese: そうだ、帰っても僕の体はふとんの中にいるんだ。このまま飲み込まれて寝てしまおう。
lines.english: Of course. When I returned, my body would still be under the blanket. I would let the current take me, and drift into sleep.

lines.japanese: 隣には山科さんが寝ている。これからは彼女を幸せにすることだけを考えればいい。
lines.english: Yamashina was sleeping beside me. From now on, all I had to think about was making her happy.

lines.japanese: 彼女のために生きよう。
lines.english: I would live for her.

lines.japanese: そして世界は白い輝きの中に包まれていった。
lines.english: And the world was enveloped in white radiance.
